newsitem.title: INDIA: India castor recovers, overseas interest seen.
newsitem.headline: India castor recovers, overseas interest seen.

text.p: Indian castorseed June delivery prices on Thursday recovered from previously lost gains, rising to 1,195/1,196 rupees per quintal from 1,189/1,190 rupees on overseas interest, dealers said.
"Renewed overseas enquiries triggered short covering which lifted prices upward. But volumes were low," one dealer said.

March delivery remained untraded as major players shifted their attention to June delivery. "Technically June delivery is oversold and fresh short covering may drag prices to 1,200 rupees per quintal," the dealer said.

Imported palm oil rose by 1/2 rupees to 283/284 rupees per 10 kg on speculative buying on expectations that the government may raise import duty on edible oil to 30 percent from 20 percent in next week's budget.
Groundnut oil on the other hand fell by 2/3 rupees to 339/340 rupees per 10 kg on improved arrivals of 80/100 tonnes while physical buying fell.
Rajkot spot oil fell by five rupees to 515 rupees per 15 kg.
